thread:
sahil: getting a weird spike from eu edge — clients do quick reconnects and we see duplicate billing for some sessions. console traces are sparse so hard to know if these are fresh connects or resume attempts. anyone else seeing this?

maria: saw the same at ~14:02 UTC, dashboard shows reconnect spike but sample rate for streaming routes is tiny. only got a couple traces.

jen: is this resume vs full new connection? any logs showing last_event_id or resume token reuse?

sahil: here are a couple lines from the proxy logs during the spike:
```
[2026-03-22T14:02:13Z] socket close code=1006 session_id=abc123 route=eu-west-1 reconnect_count=1
[2026-03-22T14:02:14Z] reopen -> proxy 524 timeout wait=150ms
[2026-03-22T14:02:15Z] session resume token=rt:xyz last_event_id=evt_987 reconnect_count=2
```

paul: looks like clients get a transient TCP blip then immediately try to resume; our reconnect budget currently treats >3 reconnects/min as suspicious. but spike has a bunch of reconnect_count==1 and 2.

maria: console sampling config is filtering traces: we only log detailed resume traces when reconnect_count>2 and when quota annotation exists. that's why we don't have full traces for these sessions.

jen: can we tag first/second reconnects with a debug flag when global sampling is low? small change: route-layer set debug_tag=1 if sample_rate<20% and reconnect_count<=2. then we can at least get context without flipping global sample rate.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary rollout scheduled for reconnect-policy v2 at 16:00 UTC (10% traffic)

sahil: canary that changes routing logic might be risky. prefer enabling debug tags + dashboard metric first, then policy change after we verify.

paul: agree. also we should avoid double billing by deduping resume tokens at the billing junction. suggestion: if last_event_id matches and last_touch < 10s treat as resume and mark billing.dedupe=true.

maria: console currently doesn't show route-level quota tag for these reclaims. patch needs to emit quota annotation on route reclaim path so console can attribute cost and SLO correctly.

jen: quick helper to fetch logs for a session id:
`curl "https://console.internal/api/logs?session_id=abc123&limit=50" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`

sahil: I'll run that query and dump ~200 sessions from 14:00-14:05 UTC and post results in ~20m.

paul: if sampling stays low we should temporarily bump sampling to 50% for streaming routes for 30m — only for the region. annotate in console (sampling_inc=auto) so it's reversible.

maria: increasing sampling that much will add load, but ok for 30m. I'll open the short patch and a rollback playbook.

monitorbot: alert: reconnect_rate_eu increased from 0.3/s to 1.2/s at 14:02 UTC (window 1m)

sahil: thanks. after we get the log dump i'll try to run a client simulator to reproduce the blip + resume pattern and validate the dedupe rule.

jen: filed INF-1234 with the plan (canary notes, debug tag rollout, metric + console annotation): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234

maria: :thumbsup:

sahil: next steps for now: 1) maria to enable 30m sampling bump + add console annotation, 2) jen to add debug_tag change behind flag, 3) paul to prototype dedupe at billing boundary, 4) sahil to post logs and repro steps. we'll reconvene after logs post.
